name: panther-companion
description: Local-first companion that explains current evidence for the current goal, and stays quiet otherwise.

scripts.build: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && mkdir -p dist/surface && cp surface/card.html dist/surface/card.html && cp src/electron/preload.cjs dist/src/electron/preload.cjs
scripts.explain: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js explain
